Text must not overlap the image or buttons, and the scrollbar must not alter line width.\n\nAfter scrolling, all four responses must remain in the lower part of the window at equal intervals. The window itself must move as a single structure without its nested sections drifting apart. The player must be able to read the entire message, scroll with the mouse wheel or drag the scrollbar, and then select any available option without difficulty.
